# A modest tagging vocabulary

Tags work best when they express a few stable dimensions such as project, status and broad subject. A tag per sentence creates a second filing system that is harder to maintain than the notes themselves. Merge synonyms during a periodic review rather than while capturing every thought.

Links carry specific relationships; tags collect loose families. Neither is a substitute for a source citation. An inbox can remain untagged until its contents are understood. Search should still work when the author has forgotten the exact tag.
